question: Under what condition does the manifest self-sign arise?
premises: The manifest sign is called the sign of the self.
It rests on the human form.
It arises when the external universe is filled with non-difference from the body.
inference: The manifest self-sign appears when embodied identity expands to pervade the external universe without difference.
plain_english: The manifest sign called the self-sign, resting on the human form, arises when the whole external universe is filled with non-difference from the body.
